description: Use when the user asks whether someone can send email pretending to be a domain. Returns protected, partial, monitoring, unprotected or broken from the DMARC policy, with gaps. Describes the policy; it does not prove forged mail gets through. Ex: 'Can someone spoof example.com?'. Free trial without an API key: a few calls a day.

domain.description: A public domain name, e.g. example.com.

name: spoofable
title: Email spoofing check
